price_reference.note: Secondary close reference used for expectation-gap diagnostics; market capitalization is calculated from the retained share denominator rather than copied from a market-data vendor.

ttm_diagnostics.note: OCF-PPE is a diagnostic only. It is not normalized owner FCF because full TTM intangible investment, advance-payment timing, working capital and expansion economics are not fully normalized.

balance_sheet_diagnostic.note: Company-defined deposits and borrowings are used as a survivability diagnostic; this is not a full enterprise-value net-cash reconciliation.

reverse_expectations.method: Retain the 2026-09-06 Base year-1 revenue KRW5.2T, owner-margin path from 16% to 18%, 18x terminal multiple and 10% required return; solve one uniform revenue-growth rate for years 2-10 that matches the September 10 price. This is a stress representation, not a uniquely observable market belief.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: About 11.90% annual growth for nine years after a KRW5.2T year-1 revenue base is demanding for an industrial business. Current backlog and grid demand keep it from being demonstrably impossible, but the price leaves little room for cycle or margin normalization.

bear.narrative: Transformer scarcity pricing normalizes, data-center and utility orders slow, new capacity earns lower returns and mature owner margin settles near 12%.

base.narrative: Grid and data-center demand remain strong, capacity ramps productively and mature owner margin settles near 18%, but growth normalizes over the decade.

bull.narrative: North American EHV leadership, 765kV expansion and data-center package wins sustain high growth, pricing and 23% mature owner margin for an extended period.

two_state_price_position.note: Algebraic price location only; not an estimated probability.

management_and_backlog_overlay.treatment: Backlog, targets and framework maximums support demand visibility but are not added to intrinsic value as separate assets. Framework value is not treated as guaranteed revenue until actual POs are issued.

valuation_conclusion: At KRW744,000, the stock trades about 14.3% above the retained Base value and requires a long duration of double-digit growth under a 10% hurdle. Business evidence has strengthened, but expectation gap remains insufficient for buy authorization while incremental-ROIC, valuation-duration and permanent-loss gates remain open.
